preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'data'))
preconditions.description: The root is either None or a valid tree node with 'left', 'right', and 'data' attributes.
If root exists, its data value is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right') and hasattr(root.left, 'data')))
preconditions.description: If root exists, its left child is either None or a valid node.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right') and hasattr(root.right, 'data')))
preconditions.description: If root exists, its right child is either None or a valid node.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the returned list is an integer.
The returned list contains the node data values in the exact order of an inorder traversal (Left, Root, Right) of the tree.
